title: Bulk labelling with a review queue
description: Label many rows of a dataset and pick the least certain rows for human review

taxonomy.description: label ids with descriptions; include other (and empty if blank rows occur)

topic.instructions: What is the main topic of row {{id}}?

combine: needs_review if topic.p < review_p; audit if abstained(topic) or topic == 'empty'; label if topic.p >= auto_p; needs_review otherwise
limitations: one row per request (the packed rows_per_request form needs a choice-typed $each the engine lacks); the outcome decision is the worst over the rows and `items` has each row's decision
for a whole dataset use the `batch` tool (resume, retry, audit sampling, review queue, exports); this recipe decides up to 100 rows
extra features (pii, sentiment), the margin rule and the seeded audit sample are the batch tool's; model confidence is not labeller agreement
notes: # deviation: spec 5.21: one row per request (no rows_per_request packing); the taxonomy must list other (and empty) itself; the 2-5% audit sample and the margin column are the batch tool's
